name: BBB business profiles
description: Better Business Bureau (bbb.org) business search, profiles with BBB letter grade and accreditation, complaint histories and customer reviews for the US and Canada.

tools.name: Complaint history
tools.description: One page (10) of the public complaint history for a BBB business identified by profile URL or bbb_id + business_id: complaint type, status, date, redacted text and business/consumer responses, with per-type and per-status counts, optional type/status filters, and the profile's complaint totals (all, closed in 3 years, closed in 12 months).

options.name: url
options.about: HTTPS www.bbb.org/{us|ca}/<state>/<city>/profile/<category>/<name>-<bbb_id>-<business_id> profile URL (section suffixes such as /complaints are accepted). Provide either url, or bbb_id with business_id.

options.name: bbb_id
options.about: 4-digit BBB office id from search results, e.g. 0825. Provide together with business_id.

options.name: business_id
options.about: Numeric BBB business id from search results, e.g. 90019908. Provide together with bbb_id.

options.name: country
options.about: Only with bbb_id/business_id: which BBB site holds the profile.

options.name: page
options.about: Page number, 1 to 100 (10 per page, newest first).

options.name: complaint_type
options.about: BBB complaint type slug as returned in filters.type: billingissues, serviceorrepair, productissues, order, customerservice, salesadvertising, delivery, facilities and others.

options.name: status
options.about: BBB complaint status slug as returned in filters.status: answered, resolved, unanswered, unpursuable.

response.about: One page (10) of the public complaint history for a BBB business identified by profile URL or bbb_id + business_id: complaint type, status, date, redacted text and business/consumer responses, with per-type and per-status counts, optional type/status filters, and the profile's complaint totals (all, closed in 3 years, closed in 12 months).

fields.name: responses
fields.about: Published business/customer response text and dates.

tools.name: Business profile
tools.description: One BBB business profile identified by its bbb.org profile URL or by bbb_id + business_id (from search): BBB letter grade with reasons, accreditation status and dates, file-opened/start/incorporation dates, years in business, entity type, categories, address, coordinates, contacts, websites, social links, local BBB office, alerts, and complaint and customer-review totals.

options.name: url
options.about: HTTPS www.bbb.org/{us|ca}/<state>/<city>/profile/<category>/<name>-<bbb_id>-<business_id> profile URL (section suffixes such as /complaints are accepted). Provide either url, or bbb_id with business_id.

options.name: bbb_id
options.about: 4-digit BBB office id from search results, e.g. 0825. Provide together with business_id.

options.name: business_id
options.about: Numeric BBB business id from search results, e.g. 90019908. Provide together with bbb_id.

options.name: country
options.about: Only with bbb_id/business_id: which BBB site holds the profile.

response.about: One BBB business profile identified by its bbb.org profile URL or by bbb_id + business_id (from search): BBB letter grade with reasons, accreditation status and dates, file-opened/start/incorporation dates, years in business, entity type, categories, address, coordinates, contacts, websites, social links, local BBB office, alerts, and complaint and customer-review totals.

fields.name: rating
fields.about: { grade, reasons, not_rated_reason }: BBB letter grade A+ to F or NR with BBB's published reasons.

fields.name: accreditation
fields.about: { is_accredited, status_code, accredited_since, revoked_at, texts }. accredited_since stays on file for formerly accredited businesses.

fields.name: dates
fields.about: { bbb_file_opened, business_started, business_started_locally, incorporated, new_owner } as YYYY-MM-DD or null.

fields.name: hq_information
fields.about: HQ profile reference for branch profiles, or null.

fields.name: address
fields.about: { line1, line2, city, state, postal_code, formatted }.

fields.name: local_bbb
fields.about: { name, url } of the BBB office holding the file.

fields.name: reviews_summary
fields.about: { total, average_star_rating, suppressed } for the whole profile.

fields.name: complaints_summary
fields.about: { total, closed_past_3_years, closed_past_12_months } for the whole profile.

fields.name: alerts
fields.about: BBB alerts as published (pattern of complaints, government actions).

fields.name: license
fields.about: Licensing block as published, or null.

tools.name: Customer reviews
tools.description: One page (10) of BBB customer reviews for a business identified by profile URL or bbb_id + business_id: star rating, reviewer display name, date, text and business/customer follow-up responses, plus the profile's review total and average star rating.

options.name: bbb_id
options.about: 4-digit BBB office id from search results, e.g. 0825. Provide together with business_id.

options.name: business_id
options.about: Numeric BBB business id from search results, e.g. 90019908. Provide together with bbb_id.

options.name: country
options.about: Only with bbb_id/business_id: which BBB site holds the profile.

options.name: page
options.about: Page number, 1 to 100 (10 per page, newest first).

response.about: One page (10) of BBB customer reviews for a business identified by profile URL or bbb_id + business_id: star rating, reviewer display name, date, text and business/customer follow-up responses, plus the profile's review total and average star rating.

tools.name: Business search
tools.description: Find BBB business profiles by business name or category near a place (US or Canada). Returns one page of 15 results with each business's BBB letter grade, accreditation flag, categories, address, phones, coordinates and profile URL, plus totals for pagination. BBB's matching is fuzzy: check the returned name.

options.name: query
options.about: Business name or category, 1 to 200 characters, e.g. roofing, Comcast, moving company.

options.name: location
options.about: City and state/province (Austin, TX) or postal code, up to 120 characters. Omit for a nationwide search.

options.name: country
options.about: Which BBB site to search.

options.name: page
options.about: Results page, 1 to 100 (15 results per page).

options.name: sort
options.about: Result order.

response.about: Find BBB business profiles by business name or category near a place (US or Canada). Returns one page of 15 results with each business's BBB letter grade, accreditation flag, categories, address, phones, coordinates and profile URL, plus totals for pagination. BBB's matching is fuzzy: check the returned name.
